$comment: Decision record for this site's design. src/shared/styles/tokens.css is the wired copy and tests/design-language.test.ts fails if the two drift or a text pairing drops below WCAG AA.

source.method: decided (no reference). A personal site with no existing brand. Direction: dark-first, a still dot field behind glass panels, where things respond to the cursor and otherwise stay quiet.

elevation.1: glass: surface at 78% over the field
elevation.2: glass-strong: surface at 84% with an 18px backdrop blur

button.hover: pulled toward the cursor; background moves one step
button.disabled: not used: the site has no disabled controls

card.borderColor: text at 12%, lit by a cursor-following primary glow

notes: Dark is the default; light is one toggle away.
The background is a still lattice. It reacts only near the cursor and settles within about a second. Nothing moves on its own, and the render loop stops when idle.

Every card on the site is crumpled paper with a visible texture at rest. It wrinkles and catches light under the cursor, with a glow around its border. Most cards tilt toward the cursor, long ones only slightly, and the agent console doesn't tilt.
Project cards also flip on click to a liquid glass back, with full details in a lightbox that morphs from the card.

The header and favicon use a clean vector infinity mark. The boy-in-a-hat drawing is the personal identity, large in the home hero and on About, as transparent line art that matches the theme with no disc behind it.
The name and contact email pick up the accent colour around the cursor. Other large headings use a soft vertical gradient.
Tech stacks and skills are chips. Sentence case everywhere.
Interaction motion stays fast (150-240ms); scroll entrances may take 700ms. prefers-reduced-motion leaves the field still and removes the rest.
Only backdrop-blur the console and header, because blur is costly when anything behind it repaints.
